title: Reject client-supplied did in ChatContact/set create
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[did-cid] Reject client-supplied did in ChatContact/set create
Spec (48e3fa1): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-did-00.md L201 (HEAD): "`did` (String, optional): A DID-referencing property ({{JMAP-DID}}): a DID URI ({{DID-CORE}}) bound to this ChatContact for cryptographic purposes. It is server-set (`ChatContact/set` create accepts only `identity`); how the server learns the value is deployment-defined."
Code: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/contact.rs:154-166; crate-jmap-chat-server/src/contact.rs:206-210; crate-jmap-chat-server/src/contact.rs:233; crate-jmap-chat-server/src/contact.rs:238-249; crate-jmap-chat-server/src/contact.rs:270-288; crate-jmap-chat-server/src/contact.rs:298; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/contact.rs:134-144; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/contact_create_did.rs:59; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/contact_create_did.rs:86; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/contact_create_did.rs:107; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/contact_did_consistency.rs:62; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/contact_did_consistency.rs:76; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/contact_did_consistency.rs:90-91
Now: handle_contact_set create allowlists both `identity` and `did` (`.filter(|&k| k != "identity" && k != "did")`, L233). It parses a client `did`, runs the identity/did consistency check on the client value, and stores it (`contact.did = did`, L298). The tests contact_create_did.rs and contact_did_consistency.rs assert that a create carrying `did` succeeds.
Change: Make create accept only `identity`, so a create carrying `did` fails with invalidProperties naming `did`. Move the identity/did consistency check (L203, now SHOULD) to wherever the backend sets `did` server-side. Rewrite the two test files against the new L201 text (they encode the superseded rule; this is a spec change, not test weakening). Update the ChatContact.did rustdoc to say it is server-set and DID-referencing. The update path is already fine: the CONTACT_UPDATE_ALLOWED allowlist at L366 rejects `did`.
Verifier correction: As stated. Also update the stale MUST quote in the contact.rs:270-274 comment (the mismatch handling is now SHOULD treat as invalid / SHOULD NOT use). Also update the contact_did_consistency.rs:9 quote 'Implementations MUST enforce the consistency rule', which the diff removed from the security section.
